We are happy to host our 6th annual #BlackLivesMatter Summit! Visit https://t.co/Yvc2INQij5 and sign up to attend (one or many) of our virtual  #BLM driven discussions!

All @CUNY students welcomed! https://t.co/fvtGrLxf36

We are thrilled that @billmckibben will keynote the #CUNYClimateChange conference on #EarthDay2021. Great opportunity to learn about #ClimateChange Education -- esp. if mandatory CCE is introduced in NY (S7341).
Visit https://t.co/ysHdGZhvTB to learn more & register. https://t.co/fF10mnYji8

With efforts underway to make #NewYorkState the 1st to mandate K-12 #ClimateChange education, we're hosting the 1st-ever #CUNY Conference on Climate Change Education. Renowned environmentalist @billmckibben will give keynote on #EarthDay2021. 

https://t.co/LdudbHCR8X https://t.co/cHTQCgJ4go
